robot: AgiBot G2, crs arms, Omnipicker x2

chassis_pose_budget.note: station arm legs keep >= env clearance with the chassis this far off; the runner must verify the stop pose to within 2 cm / 2 deg

hand_posture.roll: both grippers same orientation, finger plane level (camera side up), pitched with the approach

waypoints.name: TURN_TO_BIN
waypoints.note: turn in place to face the source bin

waypoints.name: DRIVE_TO_BIN
waypoints.note: drive forward to the source bin

waypoints.name: PRE_SCOOP
waypoints.note: 1 both hands above the bin, tilted down

waypoints.name: SCOOP_IN
waypoints.note: 2 dip both hands into the bin

waypoints.name: SCOOP_SWEEP
waypoints.note: 3 scoop forward, rolling the hands up

waypoints.name: CARRY
waypoints.note: both hands cupped together, level, in front of the chest

waypoints.name: BACK_OFF
waypoints.note: back away from the bin, holding

waypoints.name: TURN_LEFT
waypoints.note: turn in place to face the hopper row, holding

waypoints.name: TURN_TO_HOPPER
waypoints.note: turn in place to face the hopper, holding

waypoints.name: RAISE
waypoints.note: raise the cupped hands above the 50 in rim, below the frame

waypoints.name: DOCK
waypoints.note: move up to the hopper with hands raised

waypoints.name: OVER_HOPPER
waypoints.note: 5 reach over the rim into the hopper

waypoints.name: POUR
waypoints.note: 6 tip both hands down into the hopper: pour

waypoints.name: RETRACT
waypoints.note: pull the hands back over the rim

waypoints.name: TURN_HOME
waypoints.note: turn in place to face south

waypoints.name: TURN_WEST
waypoints.note: turn in place to face west
